children.name: text
children: Insert new clauses 2.1.4 to 2.1.8 as follows:

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall keep confidential and shall not disclose to any person (save for essential employees in the proper course of their duties, its legal or other advisors, and any law enforcement or other regulatory bodies (in each case to the extent necessary for the performance of its obligations under this Sub-Contract)) any information not already in the public domain relating to this Sub-Contract, the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works and the business of the Contractor, the Employer and any other third parties with an interest in the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works and/or the Site. The Sub-Contractor shall ensure that any persons having access to such information are aware of these obligations and are similarly bound. The obligations contained in this clause 2.1.4 shall survive any termination of this Sub-Contract or the Sub-Contractor's engagement hereunder.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall not without the prior written approval of the Contractor take or permit to be taken any photographs of the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works, the Site or any part thereof for use in any publicity or advertising or publish alone or in conjunction with any other person, any articles, photographs or other illustrations in any publication journal or newspaper or any radio or television programme or internet site in relation to the Sub-Contract Works, the Main Contract Works, the Site or any part thereof.

children.name: text
children: Without limiting the Sub-Contractor's obligations under this Sub-Contract or pursuant to the Building Safety Laws, the Sub-Contractor shall:

children.name: text
children: comply, and procure compliance by the Sub-Contractor's Persons with the Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: co-operate and collaborate with the Contractor, the Employer and the Building Safety Regulator to ensure compliance with the Building Safety Laws and co-operate with and support the Contractor and any other person working on or in relation to the Main Contract Works to enable such person(s) to fulfil their duties or functions under the Building Safety Laws (including the roles of Building Regulations Principal Contractor and Building Regulations Principal Designer);

children.name: text
children: ensure the work carried out by him (and by any workers under his control) is planned, managed and monitored so as to be in compliance with all relevant requirements under the Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: provide to the Contractor as soon as reasonably practicable following such request and without charge, any information regarding the Sub-Contract Works that may be required in connection with the Building Safety Laws and/or the Contractor may require in order to comply with all relevant requirements;

children.name: text
children: not do permit to be done anything which will result, or is likely to result, in the Contractor or the Employer being in breach of any Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: perform his duties under the Building Safety Laws so as to minimise any delay to, or additional cost in connection with, the carrying out of the Main Contract Works and so as to enable any other party with duties under the Building Safety Laws to perform such duties timeously;

children.name: text
children: if required, provide input into any applications and/or notices required pursuant to Building Safety Laws;

children.name: text
children: on appointing any person, keep and provide to the Contractor on request a record, in writing, of the steps the person making the appointment took in accordance with regulation 11E (considerations before a person carries out work) of the Building Regulations;

children.name: text
children: promptly notify the Contractor and (where those roles are not being performed by the Contractor) the Building Regulations Principal Designer and Building Regulations Principal Contractor of any incidents or situations that should be reported in accordance with the 'mandatory occurrence reporting system' in accordance with the Building Safety Laws; and

children.name: text
children: promptly comply with any contravention notice issued by the Building Safety Regulator relating to any part of the Sub-Contract Works. Where the issue of any such contravention notice was a result of any negligence or breach by the Sub-Contractor, the Sub-Contractor shall not be entitled to any addition to the Sub-Contract Sum or any extension of time.

children.name: text
children: If any work, materials or goods are covered up in contravention of a notice from the Building Safety Regulator requiring specified work to remain uncovered for a specified time, the Sub-Contractor will comply with all instructions of the Building Safety Regulator, including any compliance or stop notices, and any directions of the Contractor under clause 3.4 as applicable, and no addition shall be made to the Sub-Contract Sum and no extension of time shall be given whatever the results of the opening up.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall in carrying out its obligations under this Sub-Contract:

children.name: text

children.name: text

children.name: text
children: Prior to commencement of the Sub-Contract Works the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor a hard and soft (electronic in Asta Powerproject PP file or XML file format) copy of a programme (in the form of a detailed Gantt chart detailing the critical path, task dependencies, task float and total float) for the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works, and if and whenever there is any delay or disruption to the execution of the Sub-Contract Works, the Sub-Contractor shall provide to the Contractor a revised programme for the carrying out of the Sub-Contract Works and shall set out the measures the Sub-Contractor is taking or proposes to take to minimise or make good such delay or disruption. The Sub-Contractor shall also provide to the Contractor a progress report in a format approved by the Contractor no less frequently than monthly, which will include a percentage progress mark-up, jagged line and re-scheduled views of the programme. Compliance by the Sub-Contractor with the requirements of this clause 2.3.5 shall be a condition precedent to any entitlement of the Sub-Contractor to any extension of time under clause 2.18 and/or to loss and expense under clauses 4.14 and 4.15.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall work in accordance with the McLaren management plan, McLaren QA or equivalent systems, and McLaren Health, Safety and Environmental Requirements and all current regulations and codes of practice and other relevant statute law and legislation.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to ensure that all site supervisors are SSSTS trained and Site Managers SMSTS trained. Costs associated with any necessary training to comply will be borne by the Sub-Contractor and deemed included with the Sub-Contract Sum - documentary evidence to be provided upon request.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor's operatives must comply with our PPE Policy & Procedures' and wear safety helmets, high visibility vests to BS standard, Gloves, suitable eye protection and safety boots with steel mid sole. Safety helmets and all other equipment must be provided by the Sub-Contractor and must identify the Sub-Contract Company unless specifically agreed by McLaren. If provided by McLaren Construction Limited, the operative(s) will sign for the items and then the cost of same will be deducted from the Sub-Contractor's account. The agreed costs to be deducted are: Hard Hat £50.00 & Vests £35.00 & Gloves £20.00pair & Goggles/ Glasses £12.50.

children.name: text
children: Site Inductions will be carried out daily around 8:00am to 10:00am or to suit the site requirements as deemed by McLaren. NO late inductions will be made. Un-inducted sub-contractor operatives or management staff will NOT be permitted to commence work. McLaren accept no liability for any implications associated with missed inductions.

children.name: text
children: Where it is necessary to re-induct an operative due to misconduct, or breach of site health & safety rules (such as issue of safety warning notice SAF 38) a charge of £100.00 will be deducted from the Sub-Contractors account on a per operative basis (See also SAF 03).

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall allow for all of his supervisory and site personnel (including any Sub-Contractors) to attend a 'Work Safe Home Safe' (WSHS) briefing. Whilst the duration of the briefing is only 4 hours the Sub-Contractor has allowed for either a half or full day depending upon the briefing commencement time on site. This is in addition to the separately held specific site safety induction.

children.name: text
children: The cost of all personnel's participation will be borne by the Sub-Contractor and is therefore deemed to be included within the agreed preliminary costs associated with the Sub-Contract works.

children.name: text
children: Should McLaren be issued a Fee for Intervention (FFI) under the health & Safety (fee) regulations 2012 as a direct result of a breach by the Sub-Contractor, all costs incurred will be deducted from the Sub-Contractors account plus a levy of 12.5% for administration.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to provide Method Statements and Risk Assessments for all items of temporary and permanent works 14 days prior to that item of work being commenced, unless requested earlier by McLaren.

children.name: text
children: All Method Statements / Risk Assessments are to include as a minimum the following:
a) Project Specific clearly defined methodology and sequence of work.
b) Risk Assessments and Control measures relating specifically to each and every operation and activity to be carried out.
c) COSHH assessments. These are to be in addition to the product date and specification information.
f) Schedule of Plant and Operator Training
g) Personal Protective Equipment (e.g. dust masks, goggles).
h) Protection of Third Parties (e.g. public).
i) Environmental Protection Controls (e.g. dust and waste controls

children.name: text
children: The above are not exhaustive requirements and may be added to with further documentation which will enhance the safe management of the works.

children.name: text
children: Written evidence must be provided that all Sub-Contractors supervisors and operatives have read and fully understood the content of their approved method statement and risk assessment(s). Evidence to be provided prior to site induction if operatives have not been briefed on RAMS (supported by signed Briefing Record Sheet) they will not be permitted to undergo site induction.

children.name: text
children: McLaren will deduct additional costs incurred on behalf of the Sub-Contractor or arising due to any Sub-Contractors non-compliance with their Sub-Contract at the rate of cost +12.5% in order to cover the McLaren overhead costs.

children.name: text
children: It is a requirement that the Sub-Contractor visits site prior to commencement of their works in order to gain the latest knowledge of the site. The Sub-Contractor must confirm in writing any issues or concerns that may affect commencement of their works to site management, which may have been noted during their pre-start visit to site.

children.name: text
children: The subcontractor confirms that the programme for the works is inclusive of periods of 'float' to deal with accepted risks including inclement weather.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor acknowledges that unless specifically stated otherwise that they have allowed within their Sub-Contract sum for multiple visits to site and to partially completed areas of work due to other trades or material deliveries.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall make available any such personnel as is deemed necessary by McLaren Project Director to attend regular meetings during the progress of the works on site, as and when required.

children.name: text
children: All correspondence to be sent to site address for the attention of the Project Manager/Director. Correspondence shall NOT be copied or sent directly to the Employer or any of the Consultants involved in the contract unless specifically agreed in writing by McLaren.

children.name: text
children: All visitors to site must report to McLaren site offices upon arrival.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor's Payment Application must include the following;
a) The Order number assigned to the Sub-Contract.
b) A brief Description of the Sub-Contract Works.

c) A brief, but clear, description of each element of the works carried out and the materials and goods delivered to or adjacent to the Works for incorporation therein as at the relevant calculation date.
d) A statement of the Sum the Sub-Contractor considers to be due to them.
e) Supporting documentation evidencing the carrying out of such works and/or the delivery of such materials.
f) The Sub-Contractor's forecast for the Final Sub-Contract Sum.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall only act upon instructions issued and authorised by both of either the McLaren Project Director / Project Lead and Managing Surveyor / Commercial Lead responsible for the project. Any communications with the Architect/Engineer or Employer shall be conducted through McLaren. Should any further copies be required of previously issued information the cost will be borne by the Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: McLaren shall provide control "stations" with Eastings and Northings and temporary benchmark lines from which the Sub-Contractor shall set out all lines and levels necessary to execute the Sub-Contract Works.

children.name: text
children: All dimensions must be taken on site by the Sub-Contractor for all off-site fabricated materials and/or equipment. If, for any reason, it is not possible to take site dimensions the Sub-Contractor shall advise McLaren in writing within 24 hours of discovery. Should McLaren incur any additional costs due to failure to comply with the above the Sub-Contractor will be liable for all costs incurred. The Sub-Contractor is to only fabricate from drawings if specifically agreed in writing by McLaren.

children.name: text
children: {b:Sub-Contractors Own Offices, Welfare and Storage Requirements}

The Sub-Contractor will be required to provide at his own cost all necessary sub-base, compound barriers, storage huts, site offices, telephones, power and ancillary services thereto, and any costs associated with re-location of the same unless otherwise agreed with McLaren.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contract prices are deemed to include for delivery unloading, storing, protection, distribution, re-distribution, hoisting and transporting materials and plant to the position required by the Sub-Contractor to carry out their Sub-Contract Works (inclusive of free issue items). McLaren will not be held responsible for any loss or damage incurred.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to notify McLaren at least 2 working days in advance of the arrival of materials on site. The Sub-Contractor is to comply with the Project Delivery Management System. McLaren will only accept onto site any materials that in its reasonable opinion are required in order to maintain the progress of the works and are not being delivered in an untimely manner.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor must ensure that Supervision and all necessary labour and plant is on site to accommodate material deliveries for their works, including off loading and distribution to designated areas as directed by McLaren unless specifically agreed elsewhere in the Sub-Contract. Failure to provide adequate labour/plant will result in deliveries being turned away. McLaren will not accept any costs resulting from this action. The Sub-Contractor must have insurance in place to cover any damage caused to materials, plant and other Sub-Contractor supplied goods by elements of weather and accidental damage.

children.name: text
children: Ladders/step ladders or Bandstands are NOT to be used as a form of elevated access, unless a specific risk assessment has first been carried out, taking into consideration, the working height, work activity and surrounding working space and this has been approved by the McLaren Project Lead and Safety Advisor. Should approval not be given, then McLaren will not accept any additional costs associated with the use of alternative access.

children.name: text
children: If the Sub-Contractor fails to advise McLaren in good time of when an attendance is required, which either delays or disrupts the Sub-Contract works, no standing time will be certified by McLaren.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor shall provide all Temporary Works required to successfully and Safely Complete the Sub-Contract Works inclusive of its design.

children.name: text
children: Where the Sub-Contractor provides temporary works, they must also provide a Temporary Works Supervisor in accordance with SHE 005. Documentary Evidence is to be provided of Supervisors competency.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to take all necessary temporary measures to mitigate storm / wind damage to theirs and other surrounding works. McLaren will accept no claim for loss of material / time in relation to storm / wind damage or failure of temporary works provided by Sub-Contractor.

children.name: text
children: Access to site is to be in accordance with the project planning conditions.

children.name: text
children: It is necessary for the Sub-Contractor to protect their own and other works adjacent to their working areas up to the date of practical completion of the Main Contract. The Sub-Contractor will be responsible for the removal of the protection upon completion, at a time agreed with McLaren unless specifically agreed elsewhere within the Sub- Contract.

children.name: text
children: For the avoidance of doubt protection shall be deemed to include environmental requirements such as weather protection, humidity, and temperature control.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is deemed to have allowed for all necessary samples, testing and benchmarks as detailed within the Sub-Contract Documents.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor must make themselves fully aware of all other works to be engaged on the site and the extent and interface of those works with the Sub-Contract works. Although there will be no privity of contract between the various Sub-Contractors engaged on the project it is a requirement of McLaren that the Sub-Contractor shall co-ordinate their Sub-Contract works with those of other Sub-Contractors engaged or to be engaged on the project.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to satisfy itself that all previous works are completed prior to closing of voids and to notify McLaren in writing if previous works are incomplete prior to commencement.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to provide to McLaren an 'Information Required Schedule' which is to include dates required in order to allow McLaren to provide information detailed above and any other required in a manner so not to affect the agreed programme dates.

children.name: text
children: {b:Materials Supplied Free of Charge to the Sub-Contractors by McLaren}
The cost of any excess wastage will be assessed and deducted from the Sub-Contractors monies due or becoming due, applicable where the Sub-Contractor receives free issue materials.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor will be responsible for call off, checking and signing off deliveries of free issue materials. The Sub-Contractor shall be responsible for all material offloading and distribution.

children.name: text
children: No claim for any costs incurred in respect of late delivery, delivery of faulty goods or time lost associated with ordering replacement goods for excessive wastage shall be considered The Sub-Contractor shall not use any free issue materials which are partially defective, damaged, or not in accordance with the Main or Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor is to provide a detailed Builders work drawing identifying where builders work is required in good time so and sufficient marking out must be completed by the Sub-Contractor to enable McLaren to execute the works in an efficient and cost effective manner. Any abortive works due to oversized holes or chases and any unnecessary minimum visit charges incurred as a result of inadequate notice by the Sub-Contractor will be charged to the Sub-Contractor in accordance with the Sub-Contract.

children.name: text
children: The Sub-Contractor will remove all waste regularly as required to the skips and keep access to the works clear at all times. Failure to do so will result in a clearance notice being issued giving either immediate notice or 24 hours' notice to act. Such clearance notices being issued to the Sub-Contractor's project Manager/Site Manager/Foreman on site.

children.name: text
